$comment: Accepted differences between the live Gatsby blog and the new site. Each entry matches a `path` (exact) or a `pattern` (regex on the path), optionally only some `viewports`, and lists the `checks` it explains (status, height, width, meta, text, blocks, pixels; `meta:<tag>` for one meta tag; * for all). A page whose failing checks are all listed is reported as 'known', not as a failure. Entries with `normalize: true` are site-wide intended fixes: the checks they explain count as equal (the page can still pass); `liveMetaRewrite` ({tag: [regex, replacement]}) fixes a live meta value before comparing.

differences.reason: SEO fix: the new site emits <link rel=canonical> (live has none) and og:url is the page URL (live uses the site root on list pages and /blog//<slug> on posts).
SEO fix: live og:image misses the slash after the domain on some posts (https://blog.xmartlabs.comimages/…).
The live 404 page has no description/Open Graph tags; the new one has the site defaults.
